pr_title: Add the possibility to copy all the pdf text whatever the rendered pages are (bug 1788035)
pr_comments:
> A couple of the review comments regard performance in very long PDF document, and a related question is if we perhaps need a way for the user to cancel the text-extraction (e.g. with Esc) if it's slow? (Possibly we can defer that until later though, since people will hopefully not try to copy all of the PDF specification.)

The problem with the PDF spec is that it's a very long document and it takes few seconds to extract all the text and I hit: `Clipboard write was blocked due to lack of user activation`.
Chrome is better here since it asks to the user what they want to do.
So I'll need to add an exception in the Firefox case.
Anyway being able to interrupt the copying is a good idea.

> 
> Does this perhaps also fix the remaining part of issue #1995?

Note that the copy/paste integration tests alone might already fix #13317 and in general seem like a very good idea to have, so if we don't end up merging this functionality in itself (for example if performance concerns are too big) those tests can still be landed in a separate PR as far as I can tell. Nice work!
